s.zh: 不是能写进法术书的法术
s.en: Not a spell that can be written into a spellbook
Not on the wizard spell list

s.zh: 祈愿术已经永远失去了
没有准备这个法术（点“备法”在法术书里准备；睡醒后或研读 1 小时后可以更换）
s.en: This spell isn't prepared (click "prepare" in the spellbook; can be changed after sleeping or 1 hour of study)

s.zh: 变成兔子了，放不了法术
s.en: Turned into a rabbit; can't cast spells

s.zh: 被弱智术打碎了心智，放不了法术
s.en: Mind shattered by feeblemind; can't cast spells

s.zh: 附近没有能用的研究台或卷轴书桌。
s.en: No usable research bench or scroll desk nearby.

s.zh: 研读完法术书，可以重新备法了。
s.en: finished studying the spellbook and can prepare spells again.
There's no spell on this page

s.zh: 现在可以更换备法（关闭窗口后要再睡一觉或研读 1 小时才能再改）。戏法常备；仪式法术不占名额，没准备也能在这里仪式施法（原地引导 1 小时，不耗法力）。
s.en: Prepared spells can be changed now (after closing the window, another sleep or 1 hour of study is needed to change again). Cantrips are always ready; ritual spells take no slot and can be ritual cast here even unprepared (channel in place for 1 hour, no mana).

s.zh: 备法已定：睡醒后、或在研究台 / 卷轴书桌研读 1 小时后才能更换。仪式法术随时可以在这里仪式施法。
s.en: Prepared spells are set: can only be changed after sleeping or after studying for 1 hour at a research bench / scroll desk. Ritual spells can be ritual cast here anytime.

s.zh: 每个法师等级可以写进法术书 2 个法术，只能选已经能施放的环位（一环 1 级、二环 3 级、三环 5 级……九环 17 级，每 2 级一环）。待选
s.en: Each wizard level can write 2 spells into the spellbook, only of circles you can already cast (circle 1 at level 1, circle 2 at 3, circle 3 at 5... circle 9 at 17, one circle every 2 levels). To pick:

s.zh: 个。卷轴书桌的“抄录法术”不占这个名额。
s.en: . The scroll desk's "copy spell" doesn't use this allowance.

s.zh: 戏法不耗法力、常备不占备法名额。法师 1 级 3 个（魔法飞弹算一个），4 级、10 级各 +1。还能学
s.en: Cantrips cost no mana and are always ready without taking prepared slots. Wizards get 3 at level 1 (magic missile counts as one), +1 each at levels 4 and 10. Can still learn

s.zh: 没有可以选的法术（已经全会了，或要更高的法师等级）。
s.en: No spells to pick (already knows them all, or needs a higher wizard level).

s.zh: 选择蓄力秒数（0～5，不加法力）。也可以右键法术按钮。
s.en: Choose the charge seconds (0-5, no extra mana). You can also right-click the spell button.

s.zh: 选择施放的环位：每升 1 环多花 1 法力，
s.en: Choose the circle to cast at: each extra circle costs 1 more mana,

s.zh: 原地引导 1 小时施放，不耗法力（要在非征召状态下）。
s.en: Channel in place for 1 hour to cast, no mana cost (must be undrafted).

s.zh: 之后施放都按选中的蓄力秒数：火珠落地后过这么多秒才炸开，每秒伤害 +10 × 奥术强度。不加法力。
s.en: Later casts all use the selected charge seconds: the fire bead explodes that many seconds after landing, +10 × arcane power damage per second. No extra mana.

s.zh: 之后施放这个法术都按选中的环位（每升 1 环多花 1 法力）。最高到自己能放的
s.en: Later casts of this spell all use the selected circle (each extra circle costs 1 more mana). Up to the

s.zh: 打开法术书：准备法术（只有准备了的法术出现在按钮栏）、学习新法术和戏法、仪式施法、设置升环。
s.en: Open the spellbook: prepare spells (only prepared spells appear on the button bar), learn new spells and cantrips, ritual cast, set upcasting.
